key_insight: LKValues is the first survey-grounded resource suite designed to evaluate and align large language models with Sri Lankan societal values, especially in Sinhala. It highlights that standard alignment benchmarks can miss culturally specific norms in multilingual societies.
problem_solved: Existing LLM alignment and evaluation benchmarks are heavily biased toward Western values and do not capture Sri Lankan-contextualized values, leaving culturally sensitive behavior in Sinhala under-assessed and poorly tuned.
method: Build a survey-grounded resource suite centered on Sri Lankan societal values.
Focus on Sinhala, Sri Lanka’s official language, to support culturally contextualized evaluation and fine-tuning.
Provide a benchmark-like foundation for measuring how well LLMs respect local norms in multilingual settings.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, LKValues offers a culturally relevant way to test and align models beyond Western-centric assumptions. This can improve safety, fairness, and user trust for applications used in Sri Lanka and similar multilingual, culturally diverse regions.
visual_elements: A comparison diagram showing Western-centric benchmarks vs. Sri Lankan value-aware evaluation

paper_title: LKValues: Aligning Large Language Models with Sri Lankan Societal Values
paper_authors: Nethmi Muthugala,  Supryadi, Surangika Ranathunga, Nisansa de Silva, Ruijie Tao
